title: HB 553 (109th General Assembly): As introduced, permits any registered Tennessee voter to vote absentee for any reason after providing evidence of identification in the application for a ballot; exempts certain absentee voters from the evidence of identification requirement under certain circumstances. - Amends TCA Title 2.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) TCA 2-6-201(b), new, Section 1
(quote) A registered voter shall not be required to provide a reason in order to cast an absentee ballot by mail; provided, that the voter submits a legible scanned copy of evidence of identification, as defined in § 2-7-112(c), with the application for a by-mail absentee ballot.
(section) TCA 2-6-202(a)(3)(G), Section 3
(quote) A legible scanned copy of evidence of identification, as defined in § 2-7-112(c), except as provided in § 2-6-201(a).
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec 1: no-excuse absentee voting by mail in any primary, election or runoff.
(other) Sec 2: existing excuse-based absentee voting under 2-6-201(a) stays without ID ('without providing evidence of identification').
(other) Sec 4: 2-6-401(c) deletes the words 'or that category of persons otherwise'.
(other) Sec 5: effective July 1, 2015.
(other) version: Draft (only version saved): ID copy is required only for the new no-excuse absentee route; the old (a)(3)(G) is replaced (what it said before is not in the saved text). Slot c.
(other) note: Slot (G) of the application list is replaced wholesale; the prior text is not saved. 'Evidence of identification as defined in 2-7-112(c)' means the list of photo IDs. Taken off notice in House Finance subcommittee 2015-04-21; no votes recorded.
